'''Rubium deposits''' are [[Mining rocks|rocks]] found in the [[Charred Dungeon]] that can be mined at level 68 [[Mining]] to obtain [[rubium geode]]s and between 10-100 Mining XP. The geodes can be broken open with a [[hammer]] and a [[chisel]] to obtain [[rubium splinters]], the quantity of which scales with Mining level.{{Fact|Is it known whether it's Mining or Crafting level?}} The geodes are not stackable, but the splinters are, so by breaking the geodes players can remain in the mine indefinitely without banking.

Only one of the two deposits is active at a time; the moment one depletes, the other replenishes. Once a player starts mining a rock, it lasts between 4 and 5 minutes, after which the next geode gathered will cause it to deplete.

The resource-duplicating effects of [[Varrock armour 2]], [[Mining cape]], and [[celestial ring]]s/[[celestial signet|signets]] can all trigger when mining a deposit.

To access the deposits, players must [[moor]] at [[Charred Island]], requiring level 60 [[Sailing]], and permanently attach a [[rope]] to the [[dark hole (Charred Island)|dungeon's entrance]]. A rope spawns on a crate just south of the dungeon entrance. The route through the dungeon passes through a [[multicombat area]] with aggressive [[red dragon|red]] and [[black dragon]]s to reach the mine with [[rubium rocks]] and deposits.

==Equipment==
*{{plink|Varrock armour 2}} gives a 10% chance to receive an extra geode.
*{{plink|Celestial ring}}s and [[Celestial signet|signets]] provide an invisible +4 boost to Mining level, regardless of charges. When charged with [[stardust]], they also give a 10% chance to receive an extra geode.
*{{plink|Prospector kit|pic=Prospector helmet}} boosts Mining experience by 2.5%.
*{{plink|Amulet of glory|pic=Amulet of glory(4)}} increases the chance of obtaining gems when charged.
*{{plink|Mining cape}}s give a 5% chance to receive an extra geode.
*Varrock armour, celestial rings, and Mining capes roll independently; multiple bonus resources can be given.
